ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT(IF( Tour_Code__c != "", IF( AND( LEN(Tour_Code__c) = 6, REGEX(Tour_Code__c, "[0-9A-Z]{6}"), REGEX(MID(Tour_Code__c, 1, 1), "[A-Z]{1}"), REGEX(MID(Tour_Code__c, 2, 1), "[A-Z]{1}"), REGEX(MID(Tour_Code__c, 3, 1), "[A-Z]{1}"), REGEX(MID(Tour_Code__c, 4, 1), "[A-Z]{1}"), REGEX(MID(Tour_Code__c, 5, 1), "[0-9]{1}"), REGEX(MID(Tour_Code__c, 6, 1), "[0-9]{1}") ), TRUE, FALSE ), TRUE ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 請確認Tour Code格式，應為 「ABCD99」(大寫英文4碼+數字2碼)
